notes.title: YARETA's First Alpha Test is Live – Join via Discord!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We’re excited to announce that our first Alpha playtest is now available! 🎉 
You can obtain a Steam key to unlock the playtest on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/52bYkBGgA2]Discord server[/url].

If you’re hearing about the game for the first time, YARETA is an open-world puzzle adventure where you step into the role of an Investigator of the World Library unraveling the mysteries of an unknown planet. Utilize your unique rope equipment to explore, solve puzzles, and uncover secrets in this breathtaking and mysterious world.

As this is our first playtest to the public, we would love to hear your thoughts and feedback. Whether it’s about the art style, puzzles, mechanics, or any other aspect of the game, your suggestions will help us improve and shape YARETA into the best experience possible!

Thank you so much for your support. We look forward to seeing all of you Investigators on our Discord server!
